description: Remove time ranges from every track and close the gaps. All ranges are in the current (pre-edit) timeline coordinates; earlier cuts do not shift later ranges. Fragments shorter than 10 ms are dropped.

items.description: A half-open time range [startUs, endUs) in microseconds.

endUs.description: Range end (exclusive), in microseconds (1 second = 1000000). Must be greater than startUs.
